finding: isCommandMessage() searches backward for the latest user message instead of requiring the request tail itself to be a user command. Therefore a historical management command remains executable when later assistant/tool messages are appended without a newer user turn.
risk: A replayed or tool-result-bearing OpenAI-compatible transcript can re-enter command handling instead of normal continuation. Mutating commands such as reset, account removal/addition, export or update can be repeated from history; command handling also bypasses the normal session request gate on the current head.
minimal_contract: Treat a management command as executable only when the final request message is role=user and that final message contains the command. Historical user commands must be inert transcript data. Keep the separate per-session command-gate fix for state-mutating commands.
